Sample PDF Document 
 
This document is intended to test PDF text extraction using PyMuPDF. 
 
Section 1: Basic Information 
 
Name: John Doe 
Employee ID: 12345 
Department: Engineering 
Email: john.doe@example.com 
 
Section 2: Paragraph 
 
Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Integer vitae lacus nec nisi tincidunt 
faucibus. Sed euismod, velit non facilisis aliquet, justo augue gravida ipsum, vitae interdum 
neque est sed magna. 
 
Section 3: Bullet List 
 
• Apples 
• Bananas 
• Oranges 
• Grapes 
 
Section 4: Numbered List 
 
1. Read the PDF. 
2. Extract the text. 
3. Save the output as JSON. 
4. Verify the results. 
 
Section 5: Special Characters 
 
! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - = { } [ ] : ; " ' < > , . ? / \ 
 
Section 6: Numbers 
 
Integers: 1, 25, 500, 100000 
Decimals: 3.14, 2.71828, 0.001 
Negative Numbers: -5, -42.7 
 
Section 7: Mixed Formatting 
 
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

PACK MY BOX WITH FIVE DOZEN LIQUOR JUGS. 
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 
0123456789 
 
End of Document
